# Allowed entity types for entity-scoped operations

Operations that filter by entity_type are limited to these types: component, api, business_rule, feature, risk, test_coverage, pull_request, project.

Constrain queries and listings to a known set of entity categories so clients and server share a fixed vocabulary for entity filtering.
